description: This PHP source file defines a class 'ConfigMigration' that manages configuration migration tasks within the Revive Adserver project, including merging plugin configs, renaming config file affixes, retrieving plugin configurations, and deleting geotargeting configuration files.

classes.name: ConfigMigration
classes.description: A class that provides methods to migrate and manage plugin configurations within the Revive Adserver environment.

methods.name: mergeConfigWith
methods.description: Merges geotargeting plugin configuration into a specified section of the global config, improving delivery performance.

methods.name: getPluginsConfigByType
methods.description: Fetches plugin configuration by module, merging with specific package config based on module type.

methods.name: renamePluginsConfigAffix
methods.description: Renames plugin configuration files' affixes (e.g., from .ini to .php).

methods.name: getPluginsConfigFiles
methods.description: Lists plugin configuration files with a specific affix, optionally for a specific module.

methods.name: deleteGeotargetingConfigFiles
methods.description: Deletes the geotargeting configuration directory and its contents.
